summary: 11 countries today. The scaled back Korea drills and the collapse of the US and Iran memorandum lead in Asia and the Gulf, but the day also brings record low reservoirs in the American West, a paused border wall in a Texas national park, trade friction with Brussels, an ICE detention case in Virginia, and a Kenyan basketball star leaving the WNBA for the Australian off season.
